title: Asset provenance
description: <design>/provenance.json (scripts/CONTRACTS.md 6.2): every file under brand/, public/ (or the stack's static folder) and the <design>/ fonts has an entry, with its source, licence and whether AI generated or assisted it (FD09 policy row 25). Font entries name their shipped licence file.

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path of the asset.

source.description: URL, upstream repository at a commit, or how the file was made in this project.

tool.description: The model or tool, when ai is generated or assisted.

allOf.description: Fonts ship with their licence file (ARCHITECTURE.md P4, ip.fonts).
